name: EX-01 Quick Reaction Force
description: Single-day rapid response exercise (0800–1700). A QRF unit responds to two sequential security incidents within a 9-hour window. Focus on rapid decision-making, escalation authority, and after-action review. Good first template for 1-day exercises.

locks.reason: Mandatory lunch break — no exercise injections

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins. Synthetic time activated. All participants take their assigned roles.

items.title: Commander's Brief
items.description: Exercise director briefs all participants on the scenario background, rules of engagement, and communication plan.

items.title: Intel Report: Threat Overview
items.description: Intelligence cell submits the initial threat picture including known hostile elements and likely courses of action.

items.title: QRF Alpha: Ready Check
items.description: Team Alpha reports readiness status — personnel, equipment, comms, vehicle status.

items.title: INJECT: Perimeter Breach — Alpha
items.description: Exercise inject: hostile element has breached the northern perimeter of the secured facility. QRF Alpha is ordered to respond.

items.title: QRF Alpha Deployment
items.description: QRF Team Alpha deploys to the northern perimeter. Establish cordon, assess situation, request fire support if needed.

items.title: QRF Bravo: Stand-to
items.description: Team Bravo placed on immediate notice to move (NTM15) in support of Team Alpha or secondary incident.

items.title: SITREP 1 — Incident Alpha
items.description: Situation report on Incident Alpha. Alpha team reports contact, request for reinforcement, ammunition status.

items.title: INJECT: Hostile Vehicle — Bravo
items.description: Exercise inject: a suspicious vehicle is reported approaching the eastern checkpoint. Possible secondary hostile element.

items.title: QRF Bravo Deployment
items.description: QRF Team Bravo deploys to eastern checkpoint. Contain the vehicle, conduct search, report findings.

items.title: Escalation Decision Point
items.description: Commander decides whether to escalate to full emergency protocols or maintain current response level based on SITREP data.

items.title: Lunch Break
items.description: Mandatory rest period. All exercise activity paused. Personnel rotate through feeding schedule.

items.title: SITREP 2 — Combined Update
items.description: Combined situation report from both QRF teams. Current status, casualties (simulated), resource consumption.

items.title: Alpha: Incident Resolved
items.description: QRF Alpha confirms northern perimeter secure. Hostile element neutralised (simulated). Area clear for follow-on forces.

items.title: Bravo: Vehicle Cleared
items.description: QRF Bravo confirms vehicle and occupants cleared. No hostile intent confirmed. Checkpoint returned to normal.

items.title: Post-Incident Assessment
items.description: Teams compile post-incident assessments. Document timelines, resource expenditure, communications log, lessons observed.

items.title: After Action Review
items.description: Structured AAR with all participants. What was planned, what happened, why the difference, what to sustain and improve.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise concluded. Synthetic time deactivated. All participants revert to normal duties.
